name: pull-requests
description: Open pull requests from GitHub and GitLab in a pane beside the chat: the session's own repos first, then yours elsewhere, each with its checks, review and draft state

gitlabHosts.title: GitLab hosts
gitlabHosts.description: Comma-separated GitLab hosts to ask (each needs glab auth login). Only these are asked, never a host a repo's remote names on its own

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane asks GitHub and GitLab again
